title: Le Petit Fût
author: Guy de Maupassant
note: A Norman village in the eighteen-eighties: a sly innkeeper wants an old woman's farm. The peasants speak in Norman dialect, so expect words like "mé" for "moi", "point" for "pas", and swallowed syllables. The story also uses the passé simple: when you hear "elle dit" or "il revint", think "she said", "he came back".
